not_reproductions: These arms are modeled policies on this data-parallel runtime. They are not DéjàVu, LUMEN, or GhostServe. DéjàVu's pipeline streaming, LUMEN's draft-assisted progressive recovery, and GhostServe's shadow protocol are not implemented.
placement_does_not_read: workflow slack, exposed delay E, or HBM gain G
question: On the sealed primary workload, do a modeled fixed checkpoint, a modeled load-aware checkpoint and retry, and a modeled tail shadow change workflow completion relative to restart and to complete DRAM checkpoint-and-replay?

rules.fixed_checkpoint: complete DRAM checkpoint for every running Agent with at least Z computed tokens; FCFS admission by first submission; holder is the next live worker on another host in cyclic worker order; retry at the holder, else the next live worker in cyclic order
rules.load_aware_checkpoint: complete DRAM checkpoint for every running Agent with at least Z computed tokens; FCFS admission by first submission; holder minimizes (queue length + busy, -free host DRAM, worker id) over live workers on another host; retry at the holder, else the same key over all live workers at failure time
rules.tail_shadow: only the latest committed Z-token chunk, KV only; same admission and placement as fixed_checkpoint; recovery re-prefills the prefix before the chunk, installs the chunk from holder DRAM, and re-prefills the tail

unchanged: 256 GiB host DRAM, compute_dma_slowdown 0, workload, arrivals, five fault identities, profiles, hashed-text predictor, K, L, and lambda
